ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by low-intensity black peripheral margins (approx. 65% of surface) and high-intensity yellowish-white central regions (approx. 35% of surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct high-intensity regions located medially on each lobe. The left lobe contains a large, relatively solid trapezoidal light region. The right lobe contains a fragmented light region broken by black vertical striations and mottling. A dark low-intensity column bisects the fluke at the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal vertex angle of 60-70 degrees and a vertical depth reaching the base of the fluke bifurcation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel deviations along the entire boundary. Notable jagged serrations and small chips are concentrated on the distal one-third of both the left and right trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to sharp, narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) observed primarily on the dark-pigmented distal tips and trailing margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct sets of 3 to 5 parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the light central regions diagonally from the upper-outer quadrant toward the lower-inner quadrant on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive diagonal rake mark patterns across the ventral surface and minor irregular notches/tissue loss along the lateral trailing edge extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent yellowish-tan hue within the high-intensity medial regions, contrasting with the pure white pixels of the background ice/snow environment.
